n1.speaker: momo
n1.text: The gate two blocks over — it's going to open in an hour. I'm sorry, I should have said sooner.

n2.speaker: player
n2.text: (The house evacuates in time. She apologizes for the warning that saved everyone.)

n3.speaker: momo
n3.text: I'm sorry. I didn't mean to cause—

choices.text: "That wasn't your fault. You just saved us."
(Just squeeze her hand. Let it be enough.)
